description:
Looking for an apartment, house, commercial property, or investment?
  immoprofessional connects you directly to over 650 professional real
  estate agents across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Spain, Portugal,
  Turkey, and further EU markets.

  Ask in natural language:
  • "3-room apartment in Berlin up to €1,500 with balcony"
  • "Houses for sale within 30 km of postcode 49124"
  • "Investment properties with good energy rating"
  • "Office space with elevator and air conditioning"

  The app instantly returns matching listings with image, key facts,
  location, and all important details. Open the full exposé in one
  click, or send an inquiry directly to the agent.

  All data comes directly from agents, refreshes every 10 minutes.
